protocol.model: f=max(b,2)*exp(origin effect+destination effect),Gaussian log-effect prior;countGaussian or Huber

protocol.assessment: Generate only after choice seal;evaluate ridge,entropy,selected deployment policy and fixed dev hypothesis
protocol.truth: Own forward/reverse known-truth generators,public network/weakprior only;no reference or hidden path truth
